title: 第21章 说服第22章 龙雀来历
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 老妇人眼眸瞪大，而裴苏却还在诉说。
“非在下狂妄，我裴九牧将来必然继承裴家之主的位置，若我裴氏若在今后做了天下共主，那世子妃便成太子妃，再成皇后，所诞下子嗣，便是太子，将来称帝的存在。”
裴苏没有点明，但处处都是点明。
就差直接说，让姜岁柠成为他的世子妃，将来的皇帝，一半可是有姜氏血脉，何尝不是另外一种复国？
老妇人绝不敢想，眼前这位北侯世子竟然敢这样说话，竟然想把他们前朝姜氏拉到裴家的战船上？
要知道，当年夏朝覆灭，裴家虽不是主因，但也绝对是暗中推动者之一，难道他就不怕姜氏背刺？
当真是年少轻狂，还是裴氏当真有把握？！
推翻皇朝，当天下共主，在眼前这世子口中竟跟儿戏一样简单······
帝京的古老门阀，对当下裴阀联合皇后架空皇权都已经不满到极点，会眼睁睁看着裴氏登基？
以及北地陈王虎视眈眈，裴氏敢篡位，陈王第一个挥兵南下。
还有江湖宗派，虽平日不问朝政，但如果裴氏胆敢违背正常王朝更替规律，强行篡位，他们必然举起义旗。
甚至是妖界邪魔，每当王朝更替之时都会出来兴风作浪，把水搅浑。
最重要的是皇室李家，虽少了天子，但底蕴尚在，最核心的是天下至尊王气仍旧鼎盛，说明国祚绵长，丝毫没有覆灭之象。
如此重重阻力，即便是裴氏千年基业，一朝不慎也有覆灭危机，图什么？
好好的当这天下世阀之首难道很委屈？
但不得不说，如果成功了，那他们姜氏，当真就是换了一种方式重新坐稳江山······
一时之间，老妇人看着眼前这个不过二十的年轻人，神情变换。
“裴家······竟然让你这么小就参与这等天下变动的谋划之中，当真是英雄出少年······”
裴苏不置可否，那封书信的含义，便是代表了裴苏已经参与进了家族最核心的谋划圈子。
其中祖父裴昭坐镇朝堂，观天下之变，父亲裴竣镇守边关，手握十万兵权，天下无数双眼睛都盯着他俩，显然都不能随意跑动。
而自己虽然名动天下，但毕竟只是一个小辈，那帮老东西的轻视，恰好是绝佳的机会，让裴苏有足够的自由去做更多的事。
拉拢姜氏，说到如今也不过是口头画饼，消除姜氏的敌意，只要能将那位天云琉璃心留在身边就行。
“既然殿下愿意留在北侯世子身边，那便先如此了，至于以后的事，我们以后再议，想来不会缺少机会。”
裴苏皱着眉头，装作考虑了一会，点头道行。
如此，姜氏暂且妥协，也免得裴苏时刻承受姜氏敌意，虽然姜氏势微，但毕竟是前朝皇室，绝非在蝶梦谷看着那样简单，肯定有着自己的底蕴。
“不过我还是要提醒世子一句，”老妇人忽然神情严肃起来，“殿下琉璃心尚未觉醒，此时采摘，有害无益。”
她竟是直接挑明了姜岁柠的天云琉璃心，还提醒裴苏切忽心急。
“以公主殿下的倾世之姿，这让我有点难办啊······”
老妇人眼睛蓦的瞪大，脸庞竟瞬间怒极通红起来。
“哈哈！玩笑罢了，本世子的为人，阁下还信不过吗？”
裴苏一边笑道，一边往回走去。
回到破庙之前，瘫在地上的赵岚不知何时已经醒了，呆坐在地上，双目无神。
而破庙之中，武老与半夏仍在布阵。
其外，老妇人又将姜岁柠拉到一边，低声倾述着什么，时不时两人还要用目光扫一眼裴苏。
裴苏径直走进破庙，半夏便来到他的身前，低声道：
“刚刚赵岚醒后，见四周只有姜小姐一人，的确低声哭诉求她放了自己。”
“哦，然后呢？”
“然后姜小姐就皱着眉不去看他，像这样······”
content_en:
;;
The old woman's eyes widened, but Pei Su was still talking.
"If I am not arrogant, I, Pei Jiumu, will definitely inherit the position of the head of the Pei family in the future. If I, Pei, become the co-lord of the world in the future, then the eldest concubine will become the crown princess, and then the queen. The heir born to her will be the prince, who will be crowned emperor in the future."
Pei Su didn’t point it out, but he pointed it out everywhere.
Just put it bluntly, let Jiang Suining become his crown prince concubine. Half of the future emperors will have Jiang's blood. Isn't this another kind of restoration?
The old woman never dared to think that the Beihou Crown Prince in front of her dared to speak like this, and even wanted to drag the Jiang family to the Pei family's warship?
You know, when the Xia Dynasty fell, although the Pei family was not the main cause, they were definitely one of the secret promoters. Isn't he afraid of Jiang's backstabbing?
Are you really young and frivolous, or is Mr. Pei really confident? !
Overthrowing the dynasty and becoming the common ruler of the world is as simple as child's play to the prince in front of him...
The ancient clans of the imperial capital are extremely dissatisfied with the current Pei clan and the queen's attempt to evade imperial power. Will they watch Pei's ascension to the throne?
And the King of Chen in the north was eyeing him. If the Pei family dared to usurp the throne, King Chen was the first to send his troops south.
There are also Jianghu sects. Although they usually do not care about government affairs, if the Pei family dares to violate the normal rules of dynasty succession and forcibly usurp the throne, they will definitely raise the flag of righteousness.
Even demons from the demon world will come out to make trouble and muddy the waters every time a dynasty changes.
The most important thing is the royal family, the Li family. Although the emperor is missing, the foundation is still there. The most important thing is that the supreme king in the world is still strong, which shows that the country is long-lasting and has no signs of collapse.
With so many obstacles, even the Pei family's millennium-old foundation may be in danger of being destroyed if they are not careful. What are you trying to do?
Isn't it unfair to be the leader of the world?
But I have to say that if it succeeds, then the Jiang family will really find another way to regain their footing...
For a moment, the old woman looked at the young man in front of her, who was only twenty years old, and her expression changed.
"The Pei family... actually let you participate in such a plan to change the world at such a young age. You really are a young hero..."
Pei Su was noncommittal. The meaning of the letter was that Pei Su had participated in the core planning circle of the family.
Among them, the grandfather Pei Zhao sits in the court and watches the changes in the world, and the father Pei Jun guards the border and holds a hundred thousand soldiers. Countless pairs of eyes in the world are staring at them, and it is obvious that they cannot run around at will.
Although he is famous all over the world, he is only a junior after all. The contempt of those old guys happened to be an excellent opportunity, giving Pei Su enough freedom to do more things.
Winning over the Jiang family is just a matter of words now. To eliminate the Jiang family's hostility, as long as the Tianyun Liuli Xin can be kept by his side.
"Since His Highness is willing to stay with Prince Beihou, that's it for now. As for the future, we will discuss it later. I think there will be no shortage of opportunities."
Pei Su frowned, pretended to think about it for a while, and nodded.
In this way, the Jiang family compromised for the time being to prevent Pei Su from enduring the Jiang family's hostility. Although the Jiang family was weak, it was the former royal family after all. It was by no means as simple as it looked in Butterfly Dream Valley. It must have its own background.
"But I still want to remind the prince," the old woman suddenly became serious, "Your highness's glass heart has not yet awakened, so picking it at this time will be harmful rather than beneficial."
She actually directly pointed out Jiang Suining's Tianyun Liuli heart, and also reminded Pei Suchie that he was impatient.
"With Her Majesty's majestic appearance, this makes it a bit difficult for me to handle..."
The old woman's eyes suddenly widened, and her face instantly turned red with anger.
"Haha! It's just a joke. Your Excellency still can't trust my prince's character?"
Pei Su smiled and walked back.
Before returning to the ruined temple, Zhao Lan, who was paralyzed on the ground, woke up at some point and sat blankly on the ground, his eyes blank.
In the ruined temple, Wu Lao and Banxia were still setting up their formations.
In addition, the old woman pulled Jiang Suining aside and whispered something in a low voice. From time to time, the two of them would glance at Pei Su.
Pei Su walked straight into the ruined temple, and Banxia came to him and whispered:
"When Zhao Lan woke up just now, she saw that Miss Jiang was the only one around. She really cried and begged her to let her go."
"Oh, what then?"
"Then Miss Jiang frowned and didn't look at him, like this..."
